description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'SearchInstallTest' that verifies the search configuration in the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM application. It extends a base test class and includes a test method, 'testConfiguredSuccessfully', which checks for the presence of specific search configuration keys.

classes.name: SearchInstallTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class extending SearchTestAbstract to test search configuration loading.

methods.name: testConfiguredSuccessfully
methods.description: Tests that the 'search' key exists in the global `$sugar_config` and that it contains 'controller' and 'defaultEngine' keys.
